translations.Löscht unwiderruflich alle Konten, Buchu: Irrevocably deletes all accounts, entries and imports as well as the collection (direct-debit runs, collection items, returned direct debits, dunning levels). Members, mandates, contribution groups and assignments are kept.
translations.Wirklich ALLE Konten, Buchungen und Impo: Really delete ALL accounts, entries and imports as well as the collection (runs, returned direct debits, dunning levels)? Members, mandates, contribution groups and assignments are kept.
translations.Rücklastschriften konnten nicht geladen: Could not load the returned direct debits.
translations.Beiträge und SEPA sind neu aufgebaut: Mi: Contributions and SEPA direct debits have been rebuilt: members, mandates, contribution groups, claims.
translations.Das bisherige Modul ist ersetzt – seine: The previous module has been replaced – its mandates and contributions were not carried over.
translations.Einzug in zwei Schritten: freigeben, dan: Collection in two steps: release, then mark as submitted. The bank reconciliation suggests the postings.
translations.Rücklastschriften mit Mahnstufen; Zahlun: Returned direct debits with dunning levels; payment requests carry a GiroCode.
translations.Neu: „Mein Beitrag\" für Mitglieder (ab: New: “My contribution” for members (off by default) and the task clipboard in the header.
translations.Beträge zeigen die Richtung: Einnahmen g: Amounts show their direction: income green with a plus, expenses red with a minus – on the overview, in entries and under “To assign”.
translations.Der Kontofilter im Journal kennt jetzt K: The account filter in the journal now knows categories such as “Income” or “Expenses”.
translations.Der Kassenbericht zeigt in der Sphärenüb: The cash report only lists spheres with activity in the sphere overview.
translations.Nur eine Vorschau: Vor der Freigabe gibt: Preview only: before release there is no run, nothing is saved.
translations.Phasen bis zum Einzug am {datum}: Phases up to the collection on {datum}
translations.Frühwarnung: Die Forderungen für diesen: Early warning: the claims for this collection are created and the task list announces the run – with count, total and issues.
translations.Es wird noch nichts verschickt oder gesp: Nothing is sent or locked yet. Check mandates and amounts now: until the pre-notification everything can be corrected without consequences.
translations.Die App verschickt die Vorabinfo per E-M: The app sends the pre-notification by email to all members with an address – with amount, date, mandate reference and earliest collection day.
translations.Ab jetzt ist die Periode „zu“: Der Betra: From now on the period is “closed”: the amount no longer changes. You inform members without an email address yourself; the task list lists them.
translations.Jetzt sind Sie dran: „Freigeben & Datei: Now it is your turn: “Release & create file” freezes amounts and bank details and creates the collection file (pain.008).
translations.Laden Sie die Datei bei Ihrer Bank hoch: Upload the file to your bank and then confirm “File has been submitted to the bank”. Otherwise the task list reports “Release due”.
translations.Die Bank belastet frühestens an diesem T: The bank debits the members’ accounts on this day at the earliest; the bank handles a shift to a business day.
translations.Danach importieren Sie den Kontoauszug:: Afterwards you import the bank statement: the bank reconciliation proposes payments and returned direct debits for your confirmation.

A journal entry has no sign – whether money comes in or goes out follows from debit and credit. If you still want to see the direction at a glance, turn on sign and colour.
translations.Mit Vorzeichen und Farbe: Einnahmen grün: With sign and colour: income green (+), expenses red (−)
translations.Vorzeichen und Farbe an Beträgen sind je: Sign and colour on amounts are now a setting (Nextcloud settings → Display) and off by default.
translations.Das Land muss als zweistelliger Länderco: The country must be given as a two-letter country code (e.g. DE).

translations.Das Vorwarnfenster sollte nicht kürzer s: The early-warning window should not be shorter than the pre-notification lead: otherwise the claims are only created when the pre-notification should already have gone out.
translations.Der Vorabinfo-Vorlauf sollte nicht kürze: The pre-notification lead should not be shorter than the release lead: otherwise the run is due for release before the pre-notification has reached the member.
translations.Vorwarnfenster: ab dann entstehen die Fo: Early-warning window: from then on the claims are created (default 21 days).
translations.Vorabinfo-Vorlauf: ab dann geht die Ankü: Pre-notification lead: from then on the announcement is emailed to the members (default 14 days; SEPA requires at least 14 unless the mandate agrees a shorter period).
translations.Freigabe-Vorlauf: ab dann meldet die Auf: Release lead: from then on the task list reports “Release due” (default 5 days).
translations.Beitragsfrei: In dieser Zuweisung entste: Fee-free: this assignment creates no claims, and nothing is collected.
translations.Wirkt ab {from} · beitragsfrei: es wird: Effective from {from} · fee-free: nothing is collected.
